source.identity_note: Git HEAD identifies the checkout; declared-source and composition SHA256 identify the inspected working source and executing compiler output, including uncommitted changes. No timestamp or runtime execution claim.

reproduce.identity_note: Raw report hashes describe the recorded parent revision plus dirty source metadata. Committed task source is identified by the source/composition/schema/fixture hashes; a later Git revision changes metadata without changing those source identities. Full composed request and synthetic response text is reproducible from the checked-in fixture and compiler sources.
